tagline.en: China Mobile International's UK service on EE — dual-number SIM for UK–China commuters
tagline.zh: 中国移动国际英国品牌（EE网络）——中英双号、回国流量包

description.en: CMLink UK is China Mobile International's MVNO on EE's network, aimed at students and UK–China travellers. First activation needs a £2+ top-up; keep the number by ordering a new bundle within 90 days (monthly/annual) or 30 days (travel/one-off bundles). Best value: £19 / 90 days with 40GB China-roaming data. Must first activate in the UK or EU.
description.zh: CMLink UK 是中国移动国际（CMI）在英国推出的虚商服务，走EE网络，面向留学生与中英往返人群。eSIM首次激活需充值至少2英镑；月套餐/年包到期后90天内、旅游/回国等一次性套餐到期后30天内需订购新套餐，否则自动销户。性价比之选：19英镑90天40GB回国流量包。需在英国或欧盟当地首次激活。

details.en:
CMLink UK is the pick when your traffic is China-bound: mainland-China roaming rides EE's network with a native UK IP, mainland apps like TikTok work normally while roaming, and bundle prices are fixed and repeat-orderable. Its signature is one-card-two-numbers — a UK number plus a Chinese secondary number for receiving SMS and verification codes in mainland China.

Acquisition flow (2026-03 review): pick a bundle on the official site, choose eSIM as the SIM type at checkout (the direct eSIM option has been removed from the storefront at times — order the physical SIM and convert via customer service if absent), fill in email/name/phone, agree to terms, pay, and receive the eSIM QR code by email.

Activation must happen with signal in the UK or EU (mainland China activation is not supported; Hong Kong activation has been reported unreliable).

Number-keeping: monthly/annual bundles — auto-cancellation after 90 consecutive days without a new bundle; travel/China/one-off/keep-alive/trial bundles — 30 days. 5G supported, data quality rated better than CTExcel's, and it is the better choice of the two Chinese-operator UK brands for receiving mainland verification codes.
details.zh:
如果主要需求是「回国可用」，CMLink UK 是首选：中国大陆漫游走EE网络、英国原生IP，漫游时TikTok等应用可正常使用，套餐可重复订购且价格固定。招牌是一卡双号——英国号码+中国副号，方便在内地接收短信验证码。获取流程（2026-03盘点口径）：官网选套餐、结账时SIM类型直接选eSIM（目前官网购买页已无常驻eSIM选项时，可先订实体卡再联系人工客服转eSIM）、填写邮箱姓名电话、同意条款支付后，eSIM二维码发送到邮箱。

激活须在英国或欧盟当地有信号后进行（不支持中国内地激活；

有用户反馈香港也无法激活）。

保号：月套餐/年包套餐到期后连续90天未订购新套餐销户；

旅游/回国/一次性/保号/体验套餐到期后连续30天销户。支持5G，数据质量在两家中国运营商英国卡中更好，接收内地验证码场景首选。

bestFor.en: Students and frequent UK–China travellers who need a UK number plus a Chinese secondary number for mainland SMS verification.
bestFor.zh: 留学生与中英频繁往返人群：既要英国号码，又要中国副号收内地短信验证码。

Native UK EE IP while roaming in mainland China
First activation requires £2+ top-up, in UK/EU only

中国大陆漫游为EE原生英国IP
首充至少2英镑，须在英国/欧盟激活

plansNote.en: Plan terms per CMLink UK official pages as reviewed 2026-03; activation location restrictions apply.
plansNote.zh: 套餐口径来自CMLink UK官网（2026-03盘点）；激活地有限制条款。

Stable mainland-China roaming on EE with native UK IP

EE网络中国大陆漫游稳定、原生英国IP
